order: Fix a silent agent-load failure affecting the cross-vendor pack's three agent definitions. Diagnose why the harness drops these agents silently instead of raising an error. A bare colon-space sequence inside an unquoted description field makes the frontmatter unparseable. The harness's own repair pass cannot recover it either, even under normal conditions. It is defeated outright by a Windows-line-ending checkout, let alone a clean one. Fix each of the three affected agent files with a one-word rewording. Do not restructure the frontmatter, and do not add any quoting. Alter nothing else in any of the three affected files. A minimal wording change is exactly enough to eliminate the bare colon. That single change also restores parseability across the whole file. Keep the fix scoped to these three files that failed to load. Every other agent definition in the pack stays byte-identical throughout.
claims: We traced the silent agent-load failure to a bare colon-space sequence. That sequence sits inside an unquoted description field in each file. The harness's frontmatter repair pass cannot fix it under a Windows-line-ending checkout. A one-word rewording in each of the exactly 3 affected files removes the bare colon. That same change restores parseability, with three lines added and three removed, leaving every other line unchanged. We verified that the frontmatter now parses for all three agent definitions.
